schemaVersion.description: Closed AssemblyLock wire version; readers accept v1 only.

fingerprint.description: sha256: + lowercase SHA-256 of ASCII stage tag rss-assembly-lock-v1, one NUL byte, then RFC 8785 JCS UTF-8 bytes of unsigned {schemaVersion,identity,digests}; this result field is excluded from its own preimage.

generated.description: rss-assembly-generated-v1 over the non-empty path-sorted generator-owned src/generated file universe; each entry binds repository-relative path to raw-byte SHA-256.

contracts.description: rss-assembly-contracts-v1 over tuple-sorted {domain,id,version,schemaHash,semanticsHash} bindings selected from complete repository discovery; semanticsHash binds the canonical typed runtime semantics of contract.toml.
